title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-12-04

ai_review.summary: High‑energy show with a smoking Dark Star > High Time, strong Pigpen moments and solid Black Peter/Uncle John's Band, but recording source is unknown
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the powerful Dark Star into High Time, enthusiastic Pigpen playing, and classic renditions of Black Peter and Uncle John’s Band, calling the show underrated and heavy. No specific comments on the audio source are provided, leaving the technical quality unclear.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews are enthusiastic (5‑star) and highlight several standout performances; with no recording details the rating leans on show quality, giving a strong overall score.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Mix of early acoustic‑rock numbers with a heavy, exploratory Dark Star jam; fans note the show feels underrated and surprisingly powerful.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ and vocals are highlighted as great on this night.
